notes: iffor_loop unit (parser.y:365,506-521): quiet-if 'if c do e fi' is a general unit expression meaning 'if c then [e] else [] fi'; nested 'if c iffor fi' allowed; all for_loop forms accept an iffor_loop body without DO (wrapped in the '## ' drop-voids coercion), including DOWNTO; final line is rejected (quiet-if takes no else: unexpected ELSE, expecting FI).
